gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that replacing a string while using a custom variable resolver does not change the substitutor's escape character, which remains the default '$'.
ADDED i2: The interpolator factory builds a substitutor with the default '$' escape char.
ADDED i3: Use the substitutor's own toString() output as the text to process.
ADDED i4: Stub a variable resolver: it returns "}" for any variable name it is asked to resolve.
ADDED i5: Installing a new resolver returns the same substitutor instance for chaining.
ADDED i6: The replace operation must not alter the default escape character.
